source: Trained live by us with a standard byte-level BPE (GPT-2/OLMo-style) on ~1.1M characters of the public-domain tiny-shakespeare corpus (Shakespeare's complete works, via karpathy/char-rnn). Vocab/merges given as raw UTF-8 byte sequences (decode client-side) so any input text -- including non-English scripts -- can be encoded via byte fallback, exactly like a production tokenizer.
algorithm: byte-level BPE, greedy most-frequent-pair merging, GPT-2-style pre-tokenization regex
